# SolverBond
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/intent-system/src/contracts/SolverBond.sol)

**Inherits:**
ReentrancyGuard, AccessControl

**Title:**
SolverBond

Individual bond contract for a single solver

Each solver has their own bond contract for complete isolation


## State Variables
### solver
The solver who owns this bond


```solidity
address public immutable solver
```


### factory
The address of the factory contract that deployed this bond


```solidity
address public immutable factory
```


### summerToken
The Summer token used for bonding


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable summerToken
```


### totalBonded
Total amount of Summer tokens bonded


```solidity
uint256 public totalBonded
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _solver, address _summerToken) ;
```

### onlySolver


```solidity
modifier onlySolver() ;
```

### onlyFactory

Modifier that restricts access to only the factory contract


```solidity
modifier onlyFactory() ;
```

### addBond

Add Summer tokens to the bond


```solidity
function addBond(uint256 amount) external onlySolver nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of Summer tokens to add|


### removeBond

Remove Summer tokens from the bond


```solidity
function removeBond(uint256 amount) external onlySolver nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of Summer tokens to remove|


### slashBond

Slash the bond (can only be called by liquidator)


```solidity
function slashBond(uint256 slashAmount) external onlyFactory;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`slashAmount`|`uint256`|Amount to slash from the bond|


### getBondAmount

Get the current bond amount


```solidity
function getBondAmount() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Current bond amount|


### hasSufficientBond

Check if bond has sufficient amount


```solidity
function hasSufficientBond(uint256 requiredAmount) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requiredAmount`|`uint256`|Required amount|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|

## Events
### BondAdded
Emitted when a solver adds tokens to their bond


```solidity
event BondAdded(address indexed solver, uint256 amount, uint256 totalBonded);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens added|
|`totalBonded`|`uint256`|Total amount of tokens now bonded|

### BondRemoved
Emitted when a solver removes tokens from their bond


```solidity
event BondRemoved(address indexed solver, uint256 amount, uint256 totalBonded);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens removed|
|`totalBonded`|`uint256`|Total amount of tokens now bonded|

### BondSlashed
Emitted when the bond is slashed


```solidity
event BondSlashed(address indexed solver, uint256 slashAmount, uint256 remainingBond);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver whose bond was slashed|
|`slashAmount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens slashed|
|`remainingBond`|`uint256`|Remaining amount of tokens bonded|

## Errors
### SolverBond__UnauthorizedCaller
Thrown when the caller is not authorized to perform the operation


```solidity
error SolverBond__UnauthorizedCaller();
```

### SolverBond__InvalidAmount
Thrown when the specified token amount is invalid (e.g. zero)


```solidity
error SolverBond__InvalidAmount();
```

### SolverBond__InsufficientBond
Thrown when the solver has an insufficient bond balance for the operation


```solidity
error SolverBond__InsufficientBond();
```

### SolverBond__InvalidAddress
Thrown when an input address parameters is invalid (e.g. zero address)


```solidity
error SolverBond__InvalidAddress(string message);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`message`|`string`|Reason describing why the address is invalid|
